content: authentik docs: the outpost strips X-authentik-* from upstream and downstream so only authentik sets them; recommended Caddy snippet is 'forward_auth http://outpost:9000 { uri /outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/caddy; copy_headers X-Authentik-Username X-Authentik-Groups X-Authentik-Entitlements X-Authentik-Email X-Authentik-Name X-Authentik-Uid X-Authentik-Jwt X-Authentik-Meta-Jwks ...; trusted_proxies private_ranges }', header capitalisation matters, /outpost.goauthentik.io/* must be reverse-proxied to the outpost and be publicly reachable. CVE-2026-25748: malformed authentik_session cookie parsed differently by authentik's Python session validation and by Traefik/Caddy's HTTP layer produced a 200 with X-Authentik-Username set, i.e. a full forward-auth bypass. X-Authentik-Jwt + X-Authentik-Meta-Jwks exist as a signed alternative to bare headers.
